title: OPC UA
summary: OPC UA is a platform-independent standard for secure information exchange from the field to the enterprise, with an information model, services and built-in security.

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: Servers expose an address space of nodes (variables, objects, methods). Clients browse, read, write and subscribe to changes. Security uses certificates and policies; PubSub adds broker-based or UDP communication.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Untrusted certificates, mismatched security policies, wrong endpoint URLs, firewall rules blocking port 4840 and subscriptions with too-short sampling intervals.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
